Curriculum
The two-year programme consists of a total of twenty credit-courses distributed over four
semesters. These include colloquium, seminar and dissertation work. The courses other
than colloquium, seminar and dissertation are allocated four hours per week, including
lecture and practical/tutorial sessions.
The dissertation work on an approved topic will be spread over the 3rd and 4th semesters.
